kurzweil-1999-001.note: PCWorld (iSuppli) confirms Q3 2008 notebook shipments 38.6M passed desktops 38.5M; at least 50% of new PC units portable by 2009 meets D16 mainstream.

kurzweil-1999-002.note: Wikipedia Netbook confirms netbooks at about 1 kg peaked near 20% of the portable market around 2009-2010; with thin-and-light notebooks this meets the D16 20% test, but the typical 2009 notebook was only moderately lighter than 1999 models, so the hit is near the threshold.

kurzweil-1999-003.note: Wikipedia Smartwatch confirms smartwatches were experimental in 2009 and became commercial only with Pebble (2012) and 2013 models; computers in clothing and jewelry stayed under 5% by 2014.

kurzweil-1999-005.note: No source shows people carrying a dozen networked body devices in 2009-2014; Wikipedia Smartwatch confirms wearables pre-commercial in 2009. Miss under D16.

kurzweil-1999-008.note: Wikipedia Windows Home Server confirms the line ended with WHS 2011 and support ended 8 Jan 2013; Pew 2008 confirms 69% of internet users used a cloud service. Dedicated home servers stayed far below 5% of households.

kurzweil-1999-009.note: IFPI Digital Music Report 2010 (cdrinfo) confirms digital channels were over a quarter of 2009 recorded-music revenue; Wikipedia E-book confirms e-books about 3% in 2009. Measurable share above 5% in music, mainstream across media only 2012+, so partial.

kurzweil-1999-010.note: Wikipedia Second Life confirms peak of 88,200 concurrent avatars in Q1 2009; personal servers holding VR environments were effectively 0%. Miss.

kurzweil-1999-011.note: Pew 2008 confirms 69% of internet users used a cloud service and 90% would be very concerned if data were sold; Wikipedia Dropbox shows 1M users in April 2009, so local storage dominated. Both parts held.

kurzweil-1999-012.note: Bluetooth headsets and wireless mice were well above 5% of users in 2009, but displays and most printers still used cables; the Pew wireless page cited by grader B is about internet access, not peripherals, but grader A's source covers the point. Partial.

kurzweil-1999-013.note: Pew (July 2009) confirms 56% of all Americans had gone online wirelessly and 39% via laptop; ITU confirms over 600M mobile broadband subscriptions at end 2009. Wi-Fi was standard in new notebooks, so hit.

kurzweil-1999-014.note: arXiv 1610.05256 confirms machine speech recognition first matched professional transcribers (5.8% vs 5.9% WER) in 2016; Wikipedia Speech recognition confirms dictation stayed niche. Dictated text under 5% by 2014, so miss.

kurzweil-1999-015.note: Wikipedia Speech recognition confirms AT&T voice call routing from 1992 and GOOG-411 in 2007, so narrow speech interfaces were in routine industry use; general daily LUI use and animated personalities were not. Partial.

kurzweil-1999-016.note: Wikipedia Amazon Kindle confirms 6-inch 167 ppi 4-level E Ink and 1.5-3M units by Dec 2009; Pew confirms 21% of adults read an e-book in the past year by Feb 2012. Mainstream 3 years after 2009, so partial.

kurzweil-1999-017.note: Wikipedia Virtual retinal display confirms Microvision Nomad was a prototype and the first commercial true VRD (QD Laser RETISSA) came in 2018. Miss.

kurzweil-1999-018.note: The Register (19 Feb 2009) confirms Lenovo, Asus and Toshiba face logins were defeated with photographs, so owner identification was not reliable; built-in webcams were common. Mixed claim, partial.

kurzweil-1999-019.note: Wikipedia Tri-gate transistor confirms Intel shipped 3-D tri-gate CPUs on 23 Apr 2012; Wikipedia 3D IC says stacked 3D packages became widely used in mobile NAND in the 2010s. Mainstream 3-5 years after 2009, so partial.

kurzweil-1999-031.note: Pew (July 2009) confirms 62% of adult internet users watched video on sharing sites and 19% on a typical day; web pages routinely embedded video by 2009. Hit.

kurzweil-1999-033.note: The NCES 2010-034 PDF did not return readable text to WebFetch, so its figures are unchecked; the verdict does not depend on them. Voice and stylus input stayed under 5% of students by 2014 and mainstream voice input began only with Siri in 2011. Miss.

kurzweil-1999-034.note: arXiv 1610.05256 and Wikipedia Speech recognition confirm speech-to-text reached human parity only in 2016-2017 and dictation stayed niche; speech was not the main source of text by 2014. Miss.

kurzweil-1999-037.note: IES/NCEE 2009-4041 confirms no significant achievement difference between classes with and without the reading and math software in either year (one exception, LeapTrack). No evidence of majority acceptance. Miss.

kurzweil-1999-039.note: IES/NCEE 2009-4041 confirms first-grade reading software gave no significant achievement difference; no source shows a measurable share of children self-taught to read on PCs. Miss.

kurzweil-1999-080.note: Federal Reserve speech (Bernanke, 21 Nov 2002) confirms the view that sustained deflation is highly destructive and should be strongly resisted, the opposite of the claim. Miss.

kurzweil-1999-081.note: World Bank API confirms 2009 GDP US $14.48T vs Japan $5.34T and China $5.19T; the US stayed the leading economy. Causal clause untestable; core claim hit.

kurzweil-1999-083.note: World Bank API confirms China GDP $5.19T in 2009 and $6.19T in 2010, passing Japan ($5.81T) in 2010. Hit.

kurzweil-1999-085.note: Census release CB10-16 (16 Feb 2010) confirms e-commerce was 3.7% of 2009 US retail sales (3.3% in 2008); even B2B-weighted shares (about 16%) are far outside the 25% band of 50%. Miss.

kurzweil-1999-086.note: Apple newsroom (4 Oct 2011) confirms Siri shipped only as a beta on iPhone 4S in 2011; no speech assistant was a primary interface in 2009 or by 2014. Miss.

kurzweil-1999-087.note: Wikipedia E-book confirms e-books 3% of sales in 2009 and 8.5% mid-2010; Nielsen confirms digital passed half of music transactions only in 2011. Measurable share in 2009, majority by category from 2011, so partial.

kurzweil-1999-089.note: Wikipedia iTunes Store confirms 8 billion songs sold by 21 July 2009 and largest US music vendor from April 2008. Permanent digital purchase was routine. Hit.

kurzweil-1999-090.note: Wikipedia iTunes Store confirms movie rentals from 2008; Amazon Unbox and Netflix streaming add rent-to-view models. Per-minute rental stayed rare, but the main model was routine. Hit.

kurzweil-1999-091.note: Wikipedia FairPlay confirms a five-authorized-computer limit per account, but also that the iTunes music catalog went DRM-free in January 2009, so grader A's 'standard in 2009' overstates music; person- and device-bound DRM on video, apps and e-books still made the claim routine. Hit.

kurzweil-1999-092.note: BLS ATUS release (22 Jun 2010) confirms 24% of employed persons did some or all of their work at home on days worked in 2009, above the 20% test. Hit.

kurzweil-1999-093.note: Computerworld (28 Aug 2000) gives about 60 embedded processors per US household, and Turley (2002, found by search) gives 40-50; no source measures the 2009 figure. Both graders chose partial without an actual value, so the D16 quantitative band cannot be applied.

kurzweil-1999-094.note: Wikipedia iRobot confirms Roomba launched Sept 2002 with 1M units by 2004; home robots existed but were well below mainstream in 2009, which is what the claim states. Hit.

kurzweil-1999-095.note: Wikipedia Automated highway system confirms only the 1997 I-15 prototype and no operational automated highways by 2014; investment moved to in-vehicle autonomy. Miss.

kurzweil-1999-096.note: companiesmarketcap confirms Microsoft year-end 2009 market cap $268.55B and $1.2T only at end 2019; no company reached $1T until 2018. Miss.

kurzweil-1999-098.note: Wikipedia Facebook Beacon confirms the Lane v. Facebook $9.5M settlement and the Beacon shutdown announced 21 Sep 2009; litigation placed some constraints on data distribution. Hit.

kurzweil-1999-099.note: Wikipedia Patriot Act confirms Section 215 and National Security Letters gave the FBI access to records without probable cause; the access was in force in 2009. Hit.

kurzweil-1999-104.note: FRED/Census SAIPE confirms poverty 11.9% (1999) and 14.3% (2009); a 'stable' forecast of 11.9% is 16.8% off the actual 14.3%, and the count (32.8M vs 43.6M) is 24.8% off, so both measures fall inside the D16 25% band. Grader B's statement that both exceed 25% is an arithmetic error; 'continuing concern' held.

kurzweil-1999-107.note: Wikipedia AARON confirms the autonomous art program was one artist's distinctive system; generative AI art tools reached the mainstream only around 2022. AI-collaborative visual art was under 5% by 2014. Miss.

kurzweil-1999-117.note: Dragon NaturallySpeaking was the main desktop dictation product and served niche users; no source shows 5% of writers dictating routinely by 2014. Miss.

kurzweil-1999-120.note: Wikipedia Grammar checker confirms grammar checking in Word from 1992 and documents its unreliability; Grammarly-type style tools spread later. Basic checks were universal, but style improvement was not routine in 2009. Partial.

kurzweil-1999-122.note: Wikipedia Automated journalism confirms Thomson Reuters automated financial stories from 2006 and AP from 2014; automated authors were emerging while core writing stayed human. Hit.

kurzweil-1999-124.note: Wikipedia World of Warcraft confirms a peak of 12M subscribers in Oct 2010 (the Jan 2008 10M figure was not in the fetched summary); fantasy virtual environments were mass entertainment. Hit.

kurzweil-1999-126.note: Wikipedia confirms Cyber Command was ordered 23 Jun 2009 as a sub-unified command and elevated only in 2017; GAO-11-695R puts DoD cybersecurity budget estimates at $2.3-3.2B for FY2012, under 1% of the DoD budget. The claimed 'primary focus' did not occur by 2014, and no D16 branch gives partial.

kurzweil-1999-127.note: CRS R40682 confirms about 178,400 US boots on the ground in Iraq and Afghanistan in April 2009 and 294,000 in the region in Dec 2008; remote operators were a small fraction. Miss.

kurzweil-1999-129.note: CRS R42136 (Jan 2012) confirms Ravens were 5,346 of the inventory and states small UAVs are not weaponized; Wikipedia Micro air vehicle confirms the 16 g Black Hornet (2012) and T-Hawk were reconnaissance only. Miss.

kurzweil-1999-141.note: Wikipedia HITECH Act confirms the 2009 law extended HIPAA to business associates, required breach notice for 500+ persons and set tiered penalties up to $1.5M a year. Health-record privacy was a major issue. Hit.

kurzweil-1999-142.note: The fetched Wikipedia Medical simulation summary gives no VR-haptic adoption figure; a 2006-2008 Davos survey of 527 surgical trainees (PMC2483968, found by search) reports 37% had prior simulator experience. That is a measurable share, but not routine for doctors. Partial.

kurzweil-1999-143.note: Wikipedia Laerdal Medical confirms SimMan 3G was introduced in 2009; Wikipedia Medical simulation confirms simulation across all four years of medical school and residency. Simulated patients were available. Hit.

kurzweil-1999-146.note: Wikipedia Artificial consciousness cites Baars and Franklin (2009) in the International Journal of Machine Consciousness and Haikonen (2003); serious academic speculation on machine consciousness existed. Hit.
